QuestInfo.name: [Korean Folk Town] Wanted: Samiho
QuestInfo.0:
#fs15##fn궁서##e<Wanted>#n
The Samiho is a spirit that has only one-third of the tails that the Nine-Tailed Fox has. 
They say its eyes are very cute when it's smiling.
But it will go for your liver the moment it senses weakness.
Go quickly and take down 120 of them.
-Police Bureau
